title: Selecting one, several, or all locations reloads the report scoped to that set
permissions_required: A user with access to at least two locations and the inventory-reports permission.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser as a user with access to at least two locations.
2. In-stock parts exist at both locations.
steps: 1. With one location selected, note the rows and totals.
2. Add the second location and watch the data area.
3. Use "All locations", then narrow back to one.
expected: 1. Each selection change reloads the report scoped to the selected set.
2. With both locations selected, parts from both appear (one row per part per location) and the totals cover both.
